profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Motivated Senior Software Engineer/Team Lead with a demonstrated history of working in Cyber Security with numbers of SIEM products. Enthusiastic about developing forward-thinking solutions to tomorrow's productivity problems. Resourceful and adaptable approach to challenges.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Delivered high-quality products/IT services to customers with Customers Survey Score of 95%
- Built outstanding and dynamic offshore team of software engineers and developers that significantly boosted the overall success of the organization.
- Designed and developed forward-thinking systems that meet user needs and improve productivity.
Provided continued maintenance and development of bug fixes and patch sets for existing products.
- Managed and tracked progress using Agile/SCRUM methodology.
- Trained and mentored junior developers and engineers.
- Collaborated with senior leadership to define requirements and build projects that achieved or exceeded corporate plans.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Onsite liaison leading & motivating an offshore dev team of 25 people and hands-on working on multiple Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) products:
o	Security Analytic Search
- Enhanced/transformed UI to provide a complete view of a Security Analytic Search
- Continuously optimize overall Search experience for Data Analyst
- Technologies: ReactJS, NodeJS, Docker, Sails, Vertica, HTML5 & CSS3
o	Data Processing
- Enhanced the process of collecting and managing logs from ~400 devices and in different formats through normalization and categorization of logs into a unified to be used for further searching, reporting, analyzing or storing logs.
- Managed ongoing updates, upgrades, configuration changes and administration of distributed deployments.
- Technologies: AWS, Azure, Security Event Parsing
o	Parsers Tool
- Architected and implemented a tool that provides an intuitive way for customers to create a custom connector in minutes (besides ~400 out-of-the-box connectors)
Implemented a parsing mechanism so that customers can verify connector outputs within the tool without setting up an environment and a heavy Data Processing platform.
- Technologies: Electron, ReactJS, NodeJS, HTML5 & CSS3
o	Management Center
- Delivered a whole new UI/UX with 1-click deployments and an intuitive topology view that help manage thousands of devices.
- Replaced GWT/GXT UI components with ReactJS and Grommet that reduced 80% of compile time as well as development efforts.
- Technologies: GWT/GXT, ReactJS, D3, Grommet
o	Data Clarification Portal
- Enabled security categorization engineers to effectively and efficiently retrieve, import, categorize, and export signatures and automate various processes as part of security content development.
- Migrated millions of records to a new database structure to increase consistency as well as query response time.
- Technologies: Java, MySql, GWT/GXT

company.name: Micro Focus (formerly HP / Hewlett Packard Enterprise)

positions.title: Co-Founder/Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a social network kind-of web app for people to create, share and rate their favorite locations. Similar to Yelp for people who want to find the best restaurants in town or places to visit.
- Technologies: .NET Framework 4.0, Entity Framework 4.1, ASP.Net MVC 3, MSSQL, SVN, HTML/CSS, jQuery, IIS

positions.title: Co-Founder/Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a Windows Phone application that helps track and push text notification about disasters within an area to subscribers in near real-time
- Technologies: Windows Phone, Silverlight, C#, Google Map APIs
